args: dev=$(ip route | awk '/^default/{print $5; exit}'); [ -z "$dev" ] && { echo CONN_NONE; exit 0; }; if [ -d "/sys/class/net/$dev/wireless" ]; then echo "CONN_WIFI $dev"; s=$(nmcli -t -f IN-USE,SIGNAL dev wifi 2>/dev/null | awk -F: '$1=="*"{print $2; exit}'); [ -z "$s" ] && s=$(awk -v d="$dev:" '$1==d{printf "%d", $3*100/70}' /proc/net/wireless 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$s" ] && echo "Signal : $s%"; elif [ -e "/sys/class/net/$dev/device" ]; then sp=$(cat "/sys/class/net/$dev/speed" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$sp" ] && [ "$sp" -gt 0 ] 2>/dev/null; then echo "CONN_WIRED $dev LINK $sp Mbps"; else echo "CONN_WIRED $dev"; fi; else echo "CONN_OTHER $dev"; fi

args: f=""; if command -v timeshift >/dev/null && [ -d /timeshift/snapshots ] && [ -n "$(ls /timeshift/snapshots 2>/dev/null)" ]; then f="Timeshift system snapshots"; fi; d=$(gsettings get org.gnome.DejaDup last-backup 2>/dev/null | tr -d "'"); if [ -n "$d" ]; then f="${f:+$f and }Backups (Deja Dup), last run $d"; fi; if [ -n "$f" ]; then echo "BACKUP_FOUND: $f"; else echo NO_BACKUP; fi
